apps.name: Apollo
apps.subtitle: Apollo for Reddit with Apollo-Reborn
apps.localizedDescription:
Apollo-Reborn is the community-maintained Apollo sideload build powered by the Apollo-Reborn tweak.

It restores custom API support, media fixes, uploads, inline media, translation, saved categories, Liquid Glass support on iOS 26+, and the rest of the project's ongoing fixes and enhancements.

This source mirrors the GLASS Icons variant, which bundles the Liquid Glass alternate icon catalog without the iOS 26 UI runtime opt-in, so legacy UIKit behaviors such as the bottom tab bar swipe gesture are preserved.

This source is intended for AltStore Classic, SideStore, and Feather. Apollo-Reborn is not compatible with AltStore PAL.

This project is not affiliated with Apollo or Christian Selig.

privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Used to take photos to upload for sharing.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Used to save media or to select images to upload for sharing.
privacy.NSMotionUsageDescription: Detect rotations in Media Viewer and offer corresponding options.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Checked once to calculate sunset/sunrise times for the location.
privacy.NSFaceIDUsageDescription: Unlock Apollo when re-opening in order to prevent unauthorized access.

versions.localizedDescription:
Upstream asset: "Apollo-Reborn-3.5.0-GLASS.ipa"

Upstream Release Notes
Features

- Add Gallery View to subreddit menus for browsing photos, GIFs, and videos in a filterable waterfall grid with fullscreen paging, sorting, sharing, and media saving (#746: @icpryde)
- Revamp Settings with task-focused sections, unified deep-linkable search, clearer support flows, better organization, and both always-visible and pull-to-search access (#637, #695, #758: @jordanearle, @icpryde)
- Redesign profile and subreddit headers with immersive artwork, prominent avatars, themed stat cards, configurable New/Classic/Native densities, and much faster Social Links (#696, #697, #722, #758: @jordanearle)
- Add a Badge Book to profiles for browsing Reddit achievements and the restored classic Trophy Case (#689: @jordanearle)
- Add native Reddit Polls voting and creation behind an opt-in setting, with a confirmation step before casting irreversible votes (#643, #735: @jordanearle, @DeltAndy123)
- Add modern Reddit Chat and Moderator Mail for API-Key-Free accounts while letting API-key accounts choose independently between Reddit's current experience and Apollo's legacy clients (#658, #740, #750: @icpryde)
- Expand Apollo AI Summaries with bring-your-own-key OpenRouter, Gemini, and custom OpenAI-compatible providers plus controls for minimum post length and summary detail (#674, #687: @nickclyde, @icpryde)
- Add a universal Open Reddit Links in Apollo flow using the Link Companion app, so Safari links can open any sideloaded or rebranded Apollo build without the custom-scheme confirmation (#685: @jordanearle)
- Redesign the Liquid Glass App Icon picker with featured icons, browsable icon-pack cards, and more reliable active-icon detection on sideloaded installs (#668: @DeltAndy123)
- Enable ProMotion in patched IPAs and improve scrolling smoothness by reducing main-thread work across feeds, translations, previews, avatars, and Liquid Glass navigation (#724, #731: @jordanearle, @icpryde)
- Add Hide Feed Descriptions to compact the built-in Home, Popular, All, and Moderator rows in the subreddit list (#692: @icpryde)
- Show a live character counter for the 25-character Message Moderators subject limit (#751: @icpryde)

Fixes

- Make Imgur images, animated media, and albums work without a personal API key, with additional fallbacks for networks where Imgur is blocked (#729: @jordanearle)
- Fix API-Key-Free posting so post flair opens correctly, user-flair emoji limits match each subreddit, newly posted comments show your flair, and multi-image galleries belong to the correct account (#669, #670, #733: @icpryde)
- Fix rich link previews reserving full-card space for image-less sites and prevent oversized preview images from overflowing the main-thread stack during row layout (#686, #741: @icpryde)
- Fix inline comment images shrinking after collapse and expand, and keep translated comments stable while votes update (#675, #676: @icpryde)
- Fix modern Moderator Mail exposing half-rendered transitions or flickering the subreddit icon while typing a reply (#749: @icpryde)
- Fix Apollo Reborn Settings backgrounds, cards, and separators retaining stale colors after appearance or theme changes (#734: @DeltAndy123)
- Polish Liquid Glass navigation by keeping titles centered between button groups, preserving edge fades during swipe-back, balancing trailing pill padding, and keeping menu controls visible throughout their morph animation (#671, #693, #730, #753: @icpryde)
- Fix the Info Row comment action firing a haptic or opening comments when its touch becomes a scroll gesture (#739: @icpryde)

Upstream asset: "Apollo-Reborn-3.4.2-GLASS.ipa"

Upstream Release Notes
Features

- Add the Synthwave Liquid Glass app icon to the in-app icon picker (#663: @IllIIllIllIllII)

Fixes

- Fix the Reddit account being signed out after force-quitting or backgrounding the app on sideloaded installs — the account's keychain item was written with the wrong protection class and became invisible to Apollo's own read, which then overwrote it as empty; the item is now created correctly, repaired in place on affected devices, and served from an enumeration fallback so the account survives (#677, #681, #682: @jordanearle, @DeltAndy123)
- Play more short-clip host links inline: add streama.in and streamff.link aliases and follow the moved dubz and streamff CDNs (#665: @icpryde)
- Speed up loading of the full Community Highlights list (#661: @icpryde)
- Fix Video Hold Speed staying stuck at the hold speed after scrubbing a fullscreen video (#667: @icpryde)
- Fix the Mod Queue filter menu anchoring to the wrong spot on Liquid Glass builds (#679: @JeffreyCA)
- Fix Search tab suggestion padding and the Random Subreddit icon's stroke weight (#680: @icpryde)
- Fix the Apollo Classic Liquid Glass icon on iOS 27 (#666: @IllIIllIllIllII)

Upstream asset: "Apollo-Reborn-3.4.1-GLASS.ipa"

Upstream Release Notes
Features

- Add the Apollo Classic Liquid Glass app icon to the in-app icon picker (#660: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Add a Remember Post Sort toggle in Settings > General > Comments that restores the comment sort you last picked for a post when you reopen it (#570: @icpryde)
- Add a Tap to Play mode for inline GIFs and a new Inline Media settings sub-screen that gathers the Inline Media Previews, Alignment, and Autoplay controls plus a new Inline Media Size slider (#602: @icpryde)
- Play short-clip host links — streamff, streamin, streamain, dubz, dropr, bangr, and MLB clips — inline as real videos with autoplay, fullscreen, mute, and PiP, just like Streamable posts (#596: @icpryde)
- Replace Hide Bars on Scroll with a Left / Right / Off picker for the collapsed Liquid Glass tab bar (#645: @icpryde)
- Make the account switcher and Custom API settings reflect each account's actual sign-in mode and credentials instead of showing one global state (#603: @icpryde)
- Add an Info Row settings screen to choose which post-stat icons respond to taps or the magnifier, switch detail icons between popups and compact overlays, and disable full date/time reveals (#613: @icpryde)
- Add optional separate Light Mode and Dark Mode assignments in Theme Manager, with sun/moon indicators for each theme's active appearances (#651: @jordanearle)
- Add Hidden Content Recovery to profiles so you can find hidden, removed, or deleted posts and comments and view archived copies when live content is gone (#633: @ostechgit)
- Enable viewing and changing user flair while using API-Key-Free mode (#653: @icpryde)

Fixes

- Fix the Reddit account being silently wiped seconds after sign-in on devices where iCloud Keychain sync is active (#579: @ostechgit)
- Fix inline GIF autoplay not being honored under Never / WiFi Only for GIFs on slow hosts, paused GIFs losing their play overlay and opening the media viewer when tapped, and the Inline Media Size slider freezing or triggering swipe-back (#602, #611: @icpryde)
- Fix Inline Media crashes from repeated album links and leaving posts during resolution, reduce relayout lag, and show the fullscreen PiP button for inline and Markdown-linked videos (#638: @JeffreyCA)
- Remove the obsolete "Subscribe to r/ApolloApp?" prompt shown after a first sign-in (#614: @icpryde)
- Fix X/Twitter links ignoring the selected browser and always opening system Safari instead of In-App Safari when configured (#625: @icpryde)
- Fix Color Flairs reverting to grey with the wrong text color after returning from the background (#624: @icpryde)
- Fix Discussion so far AI summaries getting stuck on "Summarizing..." in Tap to Summarize mode (#610: @icpryde)
- Fix the iOS 26 media-post composer freezing when opening the "Text (optional)" editor (#623: @icpryde)
- Fix custom themes applying the wrong colours to separators and search fields, losing monospace in code blocks, and breaking italics with rounded fonts (#640, #648: @DeltAndy123, @jordanearle)
- Fix the Helios Cryo Halo Liquid Glass icon and alphabetize the Helios icon group (#617: @IllIIllIllIllII)
- Fix the anonymous install count's monthly identity and opt-out state resetting when the app is reinstalled (#612: @jordanearle)
- Fix Translation markers appearing at inconsistent sizes, showing for languages on the Don't Translate list, or disappearing after collapsing and reopening an original-language comment (#616, #628: @icpryde)
- Fix tapping a post's comment count opening at the top before jumping down, so it now lands directly at the action bar (#626: @icpryde)
- Fix Tag Filters double-blurring media on top of Apollo's own "tap to view" overlay when Blur mature (18+) images and media is enabled, including compact NSFW thumbnails (#585: @JeffreyCA)
- Improve Recently Read Posts so revisited posts move to the top and the screen refreshes in place when you return, while fixing stale, resurrected, or crashing rows during refresh and deletion (#632: @JeffreyCA)
- Fix bulk Hide Read Posts and unhide actions silently skipping 50 posts when processing more than 50 at once (#650: @icpryde)
- Fix notification-backend account registration failing when Reddit credentials were omitted from upload-task request bodies (#642: @nickclyde)
- Improve feed scrolling smoothness by reducing repeated translation, link-preview, and flair work as rows enter the viewport (#652: @icpryde)
- Fix comments flashing blank when voting or returning from the app switcher, including translated comments briefly reverting or changing height (#627: @icpryde)
- Fix long posts failing to translate and improve Apple's language detection for clearly foreign short post bodies (#629: @icpryde)
- Improve Deleted Comments recovery reliability and coverage, render recovered Markdown correctly, and stop row-height updates from animating against comment collapse (#630: @icpryde)
- Fix Auto Hide Read Posts ignoring Popular and All when Disable in Subreddits is enabled (#649: @icpryde)
- Fix direct Reddit images appearing as link cards instead of inline images in API-Key-Free feeds (#654: @icpryde)

apps.name: Plezy
apps.subtitle: A Plex and Jellyfin client
apps.localizedDescription: A modern cross-platform Plex and Jellyfin client.

versions.localizedDescription:
Upstream asset: "plezy-ios.ipa"

Upstream Release Notes
New features

- Explore: search the active catalog source directly from the Explore page instead of a separate screen
- Explore cards and detail pages show what the catalogs already return: attributed ratings, leaderboard ranks, audience counts, broadcast slots, next-episode air times, availability and request state
- File Info details every version, file and stream a server reports, including split files, extra versions, dynamic range, Dolby Vision layers, spatial audio and embedded attachments
- New playback setting to follow the server's own audio and subtitle choice for each episode, for libraries curated server-side such as Plex Auto Languages
- Pausing or seeking with the controls hidden now shows a small transient indicator instead of raising the whole player UI over the subtitles you were reading

Playback

- Forced subtitles stay forced across episode changes, and a track choice that does not fit the next episode falls back to the server's own choice instead of latching onto the wrong track and saving it back
- Double tap to skip requires a fresh double tap every time; a remote or keyboard press no longer arms one-tap seeking, and the side zones raise the controls again
- Keyboard and remote seeks accumulate into one running total like the on-screen skip controls

Explore

- Plex Discover home shelves now render instead of showing only the Watchlist row
- Titles you own are matched to your library again, and watchlist hearts load and toggle
- Anime and sequel seasons match the show they belong to in your library
- Catalog detail pages are sized to their content: related titles collapse into one compact section, scores appear behind their source's brand mark, and facts flow into columns on wide windows

Jellyfin

- Signing in works when your device name contains accented characters
- Continue Watching loads in a fraction of the time on Jellyfin 12 release candidates instead of timing out and starving the server of other clients
- Embedded subtitles in a direct-played file are selected automatically instead of playback starting with subtitles off

Artwork

- Artwork is fetched and decoded for the display it is actually shown on, so posters, backdrops and logos are sharp on a 4K TV instead of upscaled from 1080p
- Portrait heroes show the square background art Plex supplies instead of cropping a widescreen backdrop into a tall box

Settings and navigation

- The external player list shows only players that are actually installed, on Linux, macOS and Windows

macOS

- Audio no longer skips roughly twice a second during playback

Windows

- Micro-stutter during fullscreen playback on FreeSync and G-Sync displays is gone
- The in-app updater now asks for permission when Plezy is installed somewhere an ordinary process cannot write, instead of failing silently and leaving a manual reinstall as the only way to update

Android

- TrueHD and DTS-HD play again instead of failing with no suitable decoder and handing off to the fallback player, which keeps Dolby Vision Profile 7 conversion on hardware that can direct-play it
- Audio passthrough is matched to what the connected receiver actually accepts, so playback no longer freezes at the start on a sink that bitstreams only Dolby formats
- A file whose decoder stops without ending playback now completes, so Play Next and auto-play work instead of a black screen running past the end
- Watch Next shelf artwork appears in every installed launcher rather than only the default one

Android Automotive

- Playback stops when the vehicle starts driving and cannot be resumed while driving
- Head units are no longer treated as televisions, and picture-in-picture is disabled where the car does not support it

Upstream asset: "plezy-ios.ipa"

Upstream Release Notes
Highlights

- Explore gains AniList, Simkl and Plex catalogs, alongside the existing Trakt, MyAnimeList and Seerr sources
- Six new languages — Turkish, Hungarian, Traditional Chinese, Azerbaijani, Kazakh and Uzbek — with every existing translation brought up to date with the current English text
- Playback speed now goes up to 8x, up from 3x
- Transcoded Plex video behaves like a local file: seeking no longer reloads the stream, the timeline scrubs as you drag, and switching subtitles is instant
- Most single-line Apple TV text fields now use the native tvOS keyboard instead of the in-app overlay keyboard

New features

- Playback speeds up to 8x (#1545)
- Explore: AniList, Simkl and Plex catalogs, each appearing once the matching account is connected
- Jellyfin: backdrops on detail, Explore and TV spotlight screens cycle through all the artwork on the server
- Detail: the director is listed alongside studio and rating
- Detail: episode cards show the file size
- TV: an Appearance setting shows spotlight artwork in the top-right corner instead of filling the screen, off by default (#1628)
- Downloads: removing a synced playlist or collection can also delete the downloads it made, keeping anything another sync or profile still uses (#1656)
- Downloads: Android warns on the Downloads screen when battery or notification settings would stop downloads in the background, with a button straight to the right system screen
- Six new languages: Turkish, Hungarian, Traditional Chinese, Azerbaijani, Kazakh and Uzbek
- Traditional Chinese shows dates and durations in Traditional characters, Plex sends its text back in Traditional Chinese, and a device set to Traditional Chinese picks it automatically

Playback

- Seeking in a transcoded Plex video no longer reloads the stream from the server, and dragging the timeline moves the video as you drag
- Changing subtitles on a transcoded Plex video is an instant local switch instead of a new transcode
- Subtitles keep showing on a transcoded video when you change playback speed (#1622)
- Your subtitle choice carries across episode changes (#1635)
- A track you pick by hand is no longer switched back to the automatic choice moments later
- Playback no longer hangs on the loading spinner when a subtitle file will not load — it starts without subtitles and tells you (#1583)
- Next and previous episode still work on Plex when the server does not return a play queue
- When the next episode cannot be loaded, the player retries and reports it instead of just closing
- Skipping forward at the live edge no longer restarts a live TV stream
- Holding an arrow key no longer adds an extra seek step before focus reaches the timeline
- Leaving a Watch Together session closes the player even when the room cannot be reached

Plex

- Shared servers are no longer shown as offline at startup while the app is still getting access to them
- Explore no longer says an item is missing from your library when that library was scanned with an older Plex agent (#1566)
- An artist page lists their singles, EPs and compilations instead of only full albums (#1577)
- Lyrics stored in .lrc or .txt files next to your music now show instead of "no lyrics available" (#1585)
- Videos with embedded closed captions play again instead of failing with a subtitle error, and their file info opens (#1589)
- Live TV no longer forces closed captions on with no way to turn them off (#1590)
- Search returns shows and music from large libraries instead of only movies (#1598)
- The metadata editor's Advanced settings show the values set on your server instead of blank defaults

Jellyfin

- Music library browsing works again instead of timing out on large libraries (#1557)
- Libraries with no content type set now list their movies and shows
- Mixed libraries no longer list every episode at the top level (#1675)
- Recently Added lists load more as you scroll instead of fetching everything at once (#1611)
- Marking a music video as unwatched sticks instead of flipping back to watched (#1610)
- A server that redirects to HTTPS or to a sub-path on the same address is saved with that address, and a redirect to a different host now asks you to enter the final address
- Signing in works on devices whose name the server would otherwise reject, and when the app cannot read its own version number
- Server addresses that are temporarily unreachable are kept when you save a connection instead of being dropped

Android

- Servers behind a certificate authority you installed on the device now connect
- Dolby Vision video keeps playing correctly after you seek
- A video that was already playing keeps going in the same player when the device's video decoder fails, instead of switching to the backup player (#1540)
- An episode that fails to start shows the error and leaves the player, instead of sitting on a black screen while your server still counts it as playing (#1673)
- Pressing play while another app is using the sound no longer fails — playback starts once that app is done
- Subtitles that stayed invisible on some videos now show up (#1681)

Apple TV

- Most single-line text fields use the native tvOS keyboard instead of the in-app overlay keyboard; multi-line fields and a few settings fields keep the overlay

Windows

- Taps and drags over the video reach the app instead of being swallowed
- Display refresh rate and HDR are restored after playback even when the first attempt fails

TV interface

- Selecting an episode in a shelf on a detail page starts playback (#1608)
- The home screen starts on Continue Watching even when that row loads after the screen appears, and stays where you moved it if you already navigated (#1602)
- The spotlight picks up updated details when a shelf reloads
- Holding Select on the on-screen keyboard or PIN pad types one character instead of repeating
- Moving between cards and shelves is smoother
- Long Live TV guides scroll more smoothly
- The Live TV guide no longer flashes the full channel lineup and moves your cursor while favorites refresh

Downloads

- Running out of space stops downloads with a "storage full" message and marks every stopped download as failed, not just the one that hit the limit — and the app still opens afterwards
- Completed downloads no longer sit at "downloading 0%" after a reconnect
- Removing a synced playlist or collection no longer deletes episodes that a show or season sync still covers

Libraries and browsing

- Switching libraries or tabs quickly no longer lets the previous library's results or focus land in the new one
- Filters that fail to load show an error you can retry instead of an empty list
- A playlist reorder or removal that fails puts the list back the way it was
- The watchlist button on an Explore item can be pressed straight away instead of being greyed out while the app checks your watchlist
- When a server sends data the app cannot read, your last working copy is kept for offline viewing instead of being overwritten

Music

- The player's "Playing from" line follows the album of the track that is playing, and shows its year (#1600)
- Starting playback twice in quick succession no longer lets the first, slower album win, and "Play next" no longer appends to a queue you already replaced
- Collections and playlists in music libraries show as square cards instead of tall posters

Artwork

- Clear logos keep their aspect ratio instead of being stretched
- The detail page backdrop is no longer cropped on wide windows (#1588)
- Cast photos are sharp instead of blurry (#1591)

Settings and navigation

- Settings rows use the same compact height and text size as lists everywhere else in the app
- "Clear Cache" is now "Clear Image Cache" and says it only clears artwork and thumbnails
- On phones, closing Manage Libraries no longer closes Settings with it
- Back closes an open sheet on phones and tablets instead of leaving it stuck open
- Screen readers no longer read the screen behind an open sheet
- Settings you export after restarting the app keep your tracker library filters, so restoring them no longer scrobbles libraries you had excluded
- With Video Player Navigation on, Escape steps back through the player instead of dropping out of fullscreen
- On desktop, the second Back press on the home screen closes Plezy as the prompt says (#1582)

Upstream asset: "plezy-ios.ipa"

Upstream Release Notes
Fixed

- Jellyfin home screen offline loops
- Playback crashes on older Android and Fire OS devices
- Back navigation on media and catalog details
- Music volume persistence and mini-player interactions
- D-pad volume and sync sliders
- Keyboard shortcut recording
- Live TV guide long-press actions and recording sheets
- Watch Together leave and end-session actions

Full Changelog: https://github.com/edde746/plezy/compare/2.9.0...2.9.1

privacy.NSBluetoothAlwaysUsageDescription: This app uses the local network to control to media servers and players.
privacy.NSCameraUsageDescription: Camera is used to scan QR codes for Companion Remote pairing.
privacy.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: This app needs to connect to your media servers on your local network.
privacy.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Plezy uses location access when iOS requires it to detect your local network and connect to your media servers.
privacy.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Plezy needs photo library access so you can choose images to upload as media artwork.
privacy.NSUserNotificationsUsageDescription: Allow notifications from friends, recommendations, your media server and more.
privacy.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Your data will be used to deliver the most relevant ads when watching free movies and shows.

apps.name: Twitch
apps.subtitle: Twitch with TwitchAdBlock
apps.localizedDescription:
Twitch with the unofficial TwitchAdBlock tweak for sideloading.

It blocks live-stream and VOD ads, removes feed promotions and ad-network requests, supports authenticated and fallback proxies, renders 7TV, BetterTTV, and FrankerFaceZ emotes in chat, and adds app customization options.

This source mirrors the patched Twitch IPA published by gunnerkidBT's TwitchAdBlock fork. The fork maintains compatibility with newer Twitch and iOS versions and is not affiliated with Twitch Interactive.

versions.localizedDescription:
Upstream asset: "tv.twitch-30.2-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.12.ipa"

Upstream Release Notes
TwitchMods v0.1.12 — for Twitch iOS 30.2

Same features as v0.1.12, rebuilt to run on the latest Twitch app (30.2). All
hooks verified against the 30.2 binary; no feature changes.

What's included (v0.1.12)
- Blocks ads — live + VOD pre-rolls via proxy, feed ad banners, sponsor spots, and the Following-tab "Go Ad-Free" Turbo button.
- Keep Live Feed Playing — no more getting kicked to Watch/Follow.
- Chat emotes — 7TV / BetterTTV / FrankerFaceZ, plus a Reload Emotes button.
- Back up & restore your settings, and a Diagnostics screen.
- Pick your launch screen, hide Twitch Stories, clearer settings.

Downloads
- "tv.twitch-30.2-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.12.ipa" — full app.
- "tv.twitch-30.2-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.12-noplugins.ipa" — app extensions removed so a free Apple ID only uses 1 App ID slot when sideloading.

Install with AltStore / SideStore (drag in the IPA) or TrollStore (tap +, pick the IPA).

Full plain-language changelog: ["CHANGELOG.md"](https://github.com/gunnerkidBT/TwitchAdBlock/blob/master/CHANGELOG.md)

TwitchMods v0.1.12 — for Twitch iOS 29.9

What's new
- The Live tab keeps playing — no more getting kicked to Watch/Follow after a while.
- Hid the "Go Ad-Free" button (the Turbo upsell) on the Following tab.
- Blocks a few more ads — streamer-read sponsor spots.

- Back up & restore your settings — export to a file and import it back later.
- Diagnostics screen — a quick green/red check that the mod still works on your Twitch version.
- Easier-to-read settings — a short description under each option, grouped under clear headings.

Upstream Release Notes
Twitch iOS 29.9 compatibility build of TwitchAdBlock v0.1.11.

No mod changes — the tweak source and compiled "TwitchAdBlock.dylib" are byte-identical to [v29.8-0.1.11](https://github.com/gunnerkidBT/TwitchAdBlock/releases/tag/v29.8-0.1.11). Only the host app was updated from 29.8 to 29.9 and the same dylib re-injected. All hooked classes were verified to still resolve in the 29.9 binary.

Downloads
- "tv.twitch-29.9-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.11.ipa" — full build (includes all 5 of Twitch's app extensions).
- "tv.twitch-29.9-TwitchAdBlock-0.1.11-noplugins.ipa" — plugin-free build. The 5 app extensions (GameBroadcasting, NotificationService, Share Extension, TwitchEmotes, TwitchWidgets) are stripped out. Recommended for free Apple ID accounts, which are limited to 10 App IDs per 7 days: the full build registers 6 App IDs (main app + 5 extensions), while this build registers only 1. Core stream-watching, chat, custom emotes, and ad-blocking are unaffected; you lose home-screen widgets, screen broadcasting, the "Share to Twitch" share-sheet action, the iMessage emote stickers, and rich (image) push notifications — basic push notifications still work.

Install
Download an IPA and install via AltStore / SideStore (drag in to sign) or TrollStore ("+" → select IPA).
